purpose: Test opening events whose attraction comes from 罗钧's next behavioral choice, not from occupation spectacle, event stakes, mystery, trauma explanation or generic twist.
constraints: Do not revive 江衡/闻雪.
Do not reuse rejected kitchen-crisis, escort-route, car-inspection, static moral-tableau patterns.
No childhood trauma, complete psychological diagnosis, neat mirrored origin, aphoristic line, forced accident, or inflated stakes.
Reader knows material facts; curiosity must center on 罗钧's choice.

reviewer_attacks.SWAP_PROTAGONIST: If the event remains equally attractive with another decent/competent protagonist, FAIL.
reviewer_attacks.HUMAN_MESSINESS: 罗钧 must retain contradictory or non-totalized behavior; event may not reduce him to one trait demonstration.
reviewer_attacks.AUTHOR_THESIS_DEPENDENCY: If the scene exists mainly to prove the card's stated personality thesis, FAIL.
reviewer_attacks.CONTINUATION_VALUE: After the local event resolves, reader must still want to observe 罗钧's next choices rather than merely know the event outcome.
